author: Shift Supervisor
text: Day shift handover: line steady at 18000 sm3/d on A1-FT-1010, mainline pumps A1-P-1003A and B on duty, C on standby. Tank E1-T-5001C at 30%.

author: Terminal Operator
text: Tanker alongside at the jetty. Lined up E1-T-5001C to the loading pumps; F1-P-6001A on duty, custody meter F1-FT-6010 proved this morning.

author: Shift Supervisor
text: Night shift handover: loading on F1-FT-6010, VRU G1-K-7001 running, tank vapour header 6 mbarg.

author: Pipeline Controller
text: Origin A1-FT-1010 and terminal D1-FT-4002 disagree by about 3%; line pack steady. Asked the metering technician to look at D1-FT-4002 diagnostics.

author: Field Operator
text: A1-PDT-1007 strainer dP 0.4 bar and climbing. Wax in the basket again; strainer change-over planned for the weekend.

author: Field Operator
text: G1-K-7001 cylinder 2 discharge running hot to the touch. Raised a notification for the rotating equipment crew.

author: Field Operator
text: Seal leak on midline pump B1-P-2001A, crude on the baseplate. Stopped A and started B1-P-2001B. Spill contained.

author: Shift Supervisor
text: Notification raised for B1-P-2001A mechanical seal. Midline running on B only, no standby.

author: Shift Supervisor
text: Day shift handover: tanker sailed. B1-P-2001A isolated for seal change, permit pending.

author: Lab Technician
text: Receipt sample BS&W 0.4 vol%, within the 0.5 limit. Tank E1-T-5001A sampled for RVP.

author: Terminal Operator
text: VRU G1-K-7001 tripped on high discharge temperature. Aftercooler G1-E-7003 fan not turning; belt off. Tank vapours to the thermal oxidiser H1-H-8006.

author: Terminal Operator
text: Tank vapour header E1-PT-5003 at 18 mbarg. Held receipts steady; the oxidiser is taking it.

author: Shift Supervisor
text: Day shift handover: belt replaced on G1-E-7003 by the night electrician. VRU restart after the fan check.

author: Terminal Operator
text: G1-K-7001 restarted and loaded. Vapours back to the VRU, oxidiser flow back to purge.

author: Shift Supervisor
text: Night shift handover: VRU steady, discharge temperature 118 degC. Midline still on B1-P-2001B only.

author: Shift Supervisor
text: Day shift handover: line steady. Next tanker due at noon; E1-T-5001A at 80% to load.
